name: Goldenrod Gym (Plain Badge Duel)
summary: Enter the floral corridors of the Goldenrod Gym. Collect your complimentary Poké Doll from the greeter, solve the Pokémon counting puzzle, and challenge Gym Leader Whitney to an intense 5v5 showdown for the Plain Badge under the Level 62 cap.

items.name: Poké Doll
items.method: Gifted by the gym usher upon crossing the entrance threshold

items.name: Plain Badge
items.method: Awarded by Gym Leader Whitney upon defeat (unlocks the use of Strength outside battle)

items.name: TM45 Attract
items.method: Gift from Whitney following the battle once she stops crying
